summary: Kanban task board JSON API with workflow columns, board summary and live search.

defects.title: Workflow allows moving a done task back to review
defects.description: canMove() permits any move one column back, ignoring NEXT_STATUSES. A done task (whose only allowed next step is archived) can be moved back to review, reopening finished work.
defects.trigger: Move a task todo -> in_progress -> review -> done, then POST /tasks/:id/move {"to":"review"}
defects.observed: 200 with status=review although the advertised next steps for done are ["archived"].

defects.title: PATCH copies every request field onto the task
defects.description: applyPatch() spreads the whole request body over the stored task, so clients can overwrite ownerId, status and even id, bypassing the move workflow and ownership.
defects.observed: 200; the task is archived, owned by mallory and renumbered to 4242.

defects.title: Moving an unknown task dereferences undefined
defects.description: moveTask() casts the result of tasks.find() to Task and reads task.status without checking for undefined.
defects.observed: 500 with TypeError "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'status')" instead of 404.

defects.title: Completion percentage divides by zero active tasks
defects.description: completionPercent() divides by the number of non-archived tasks, which is 0 on an empty board or when every task is archived; the NaN is serialised as null.

defects.title: Search query compiled as a regular expression
defects.description: searchTasks() turns the user-supplied q into a RegExp. A catastrophic-backtracking pattern blocks the single-threaded server; malformed patterns throw.
defects.trigger: Create a task titled 'aaaa...a!' (29 a's) then GET /search?q=^(a+)+$
defects.observed: The request takes seconds and stalls every other request meanwhile.

defects.title: Column ids sorted as strings
defects.description: columnOrder() calls Array.prototype.sort() without a comparator, so numeric ids are ordered lexicographically (1, 10, 11, 2, ...) instead of oldest first.
defects.trigger: Create more than ten tasks and GET /board
defects.observed: todo ids like [2, 3, 10, 11, ..., 4, 5] out of creation order.

defects.title: Non-numeric priority stored as NaN
defects.description: parsePriority() uses parseInt without a NaN check; NaN fails neither range comparison, so it is accepted and stored, breaking later priority comparisons.

defects.title: Search results render task titles as raw HTML
defects.description: renderResults() interpolates task titles into the HTML fragment without escaping, so any user can store markup that runs in other users' board pages.
defects.trigger: Create a task titled and GET /search?q=onerror
defects.observed: text/html response contains the img tag verbatim.

defects.title: Request bodies and task fields have no size limit
defects.description: readBody() buffers the entire request in memory and newTask() stores titles of any length in the unbounded in-memory task list.
defects.observed: 201; the 12 MiB title is kept in memory.

defects.title: Any user can move another user's task
defects.description: handlePatch() checks that X-User owns the task, but handleMove() only requires some X-User value before moving the task.
defects.trigger: alice creates a task; POST /tasks/:id/move as X-User: mallory

defects.title: Internal errors return the stack trace
defects.description: sendError() includes err.stack in 500 responses, exposing source paths and internals to clients.
defects.observed: 500 JSON with a stack containing absolute paths to board.ts.

defects.title: Each search page drops its last item
defects.description: paginate() treats the slice end as inclusive, returning size-1 items per page; the item at the end of each page never appears on any page.
defects.trigger: Three tasks match; GET /search?q=pagetest&size=2&page=1 and page=2
defects.observed: Page 1 has 1 item, page 2 has 1 item; one match is never shown.
